name: otel
description: OpenTelemetry instrumentation — auto-instrumentation, Pino structured logging, category-based filtering

health_checks.name: otel-instrumentation-exists
health_checks.command: test -f instrumentation.ts || test -f src/instrumentation.ts || test -f instrumentation.py || test -f src/instrumentation.py

health_checks.name: otel-packages-installed
health_checks.command: node -e "const r=(p)=>{try{require.resolve(p,{paths:[process.cwd()]});return true}catch{return false}};process.exit(['@opentelemetry/sdk-node','@vercel/otel','@opentelemetry/sdk-trace-web'].some(r)?0:1)" 2>/dev/null || python3 -c "import opentelemetry" 2>/dev/null || python -c "import opentelemetry" 2>/dev/null

verification: test -f instrumentation.ts || test -f src/instrumentation.ts || test -f instrumentation.py
